name: Lavabound
detailed_description:
Lavabound is a 'relaxed' and fun cooperative platformer, which you can play solo or together. Timing and teamwork is of the essence whilst navigating trough the different levels. Are you able to collect all the treasures and escape before the volcano erupts? 

Solo and Multiplayer

Easily switch between both characters when you play solo, or take over the controls of Razor and Ember with a friend. 

Rising Lava

The volcano is about to erupt and it's your task to keep ahead of the rising lava, since even dragons can't manage that kind of heat.

Collect Treasures

Additional challenge is added when you try to collect all the treasures. Are you able to collect them all without getting caught by the lava? 

Speed is everything

Try to be as fast as you can. Every level is easily re-playable and your fastest time will be shown in the menu. Compare your fastest time with your friends to see who's really the faster dragon.

short_description: Play alone or play together in this 'relaxed' and fun cooperative platformer. Can you collect all the treasures whilst navigating through different obstacles? And if this doesn't sound hard enough for you: Please be aware of the constant rising lava. Will you successfully escape the volcano?
